description: This Java source file implements a WebDAV servlet for the Apache OFBiz framework. The class `WebDavServlet` extends `GenericServlet` and handles WebDAV requests by forwarding them to a `RequestHandler`. It manages servlet initialization parameters, sets up security, delegator, dispatcher, and handler factory components, and handles the request processing lifecycle.

classes.name: WebDavServlet
classes.description: A servlet class that handles WebDAV protocol requests by delegating to a request handler obtained via configuration. Manages servlet lifecycle events such as initialization and request servicing, sets up dependencies, and manages session lifecycle.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the servlet, retrieving configuration parameters, setting up delegator, dispatcher, security, and request handler factory, with error handling and verbose logging.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Handles incoming servlet requests by setting context attributes, obtaining a request handler, processing the request, and ensuring session invalidation after handling.
